dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure Iotham will grow up, healthy and strong.

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Thank you, little guest. Iotham has told me so much about you. He admires you a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: You're still young with much room for growth. Keep a healthy diet, and you can be stronger. Now, these are for you.

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Come back to Vimara Village if you ever feel tired or need a break. Iotham will be happy to see you.
